messages:
deploy-bot: starting controlled v2 flip: 15% NA/EU -> rl-2026-06-v2-02. ramp policy: 15 -> 40 in 20m.

kyle: note — this rollout enables X-API-Version header only. requests without header continue to v1. we're shipping a short-lived compat shim.

ana: can we add explicit pins for a few high-volume tenants in case of issues? want quick commands in the runbook.

ops-oncall: yes. runbook snippet: `deploybot pin tenant=ID version=v1 reason=compat_shim`. Add alert: 5xx > 1.5% for 3m or p95 up >300ms for 10m -> notify ops.

kyle: added a metric `shim_mapped_to_v1`. also instrumented `client_header_set_pct`.

docs-bot: created draft release notes: https://confluence.redwood.example/rl-2026-06-v2-02. includes header examples and SDK tips.

ana: sample curl for notes?

kyle: sure:
````
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-API-Version: 2" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'
````

ops-oncall: ramp snapshot at 30%: 5xx_rate=0.0008, p95=190ms, client_header_set_pct=89.2%, shim_mapped_to_v1=10.3%.

nana: shim_mapped_to_v1 is a bit high — which tenants?

kyle: telemetry shows tenant=sprocket-inc at 28% missing header. I'll add them to the pin watchlist.

ops-oncall: will pin if >30% for 15m. command at hand.

docs-bot: added note: "compat shim will be removed after 14 days or when missing-header <1%"

nana: please also call out endpoints with changed response shapes. small table added to the docs.

kyle: agreed. adding eval hooks to watch for schema regressions on those endpoints.

deploy-bot: ramp to 40% completed. metrics: 5xx_rate=0.0009, p95=205ms, client_header_set_pct=90.1%, shim_mapped_to_v1=9.1%.

ops-oncall: holding monitoring for 1h. ping me if alerts fire. :eyes:
